    '-I'+str(base/'source/include'),'-I'+str(base/'source/lib/qdldl/include'),
    'cpp/cuda/tests/qoco_metric_graph_benchmark.cu','-L'+str(base/'final'),'-lqoco','-ldl','-o',str(target)],check=True)
target.chmod(0o555)
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('SPACEPDHCG_TEST_')}
env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH']=str(base/'final')+':/home/angus/cudss-isolated-0.8.0.10/nvidia/cu12/lib:/usr/local/cuda-12.8/lib64'
with Path('/home/angus/.spacepdhcg-gpu.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    run=subprocess.run([str(target)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180)
assert run.returncode==0,run.stdout+run.stderr
samples=[json.loads(line) for line in run.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('{')]
assert len(samples)==54 and all(s['passed'] for s in samples)
medians={}
for n in [17,4103,100000]:
    medians[n]={}

        rows=[s for s in samples if s['n']==n and s['graph']==graph and not s['warmup']]

Path('artifacts/performance/qoco-metric-graphs-v76-microbenchmark.json').write_text(json.dumps({

Matrix/vector setup and scope teardown excluded; full trajectory benchmarks separately include real graph construction and solve lifetimes.',
    'command':[str(target)],'returncode':run.returncode,'samples':samples,'medians':medians,
    'sha256':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in [target,base/'final/libqoco.so']}},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(medians,indent=2))
